content.body:
We're hosting a **48‑hour global marathon** uniting two distinct creative worlds of **Video Editors** and **Web Developers**. This competition will be challenging the **Video Editors**: You will receive a highly modular, 6‑minute 'Doing Nothing' cinematic footage pack. Your goal is to use the Kuleshov Effect to cut a 90‑second narrative (Thriller, Comedy, Action) using only this neutral footage… Make it highly engaging!
While challenging **Web Developers**: You will simultaneously code live, custom JavaScript (.js) extensions to upgrade the **WASM Video Editor** while it is being used, building tools that directly assist the editors in achieving their vision. There are links to the documentation for each aspect of the modularization you'll want as a web developer.
1. All editing must be done exclusively within the **Forge™ WASM Video Editor**.
2. Final cuts must not exceed 90 seconds.
3. Developers must submit their **.js** extension files alongside the video project made by the video editor they partner with.

Through our partnership with the **Jamaica Game Developer Society (JGDS)** and global indie game developer sponsors, we have curated a massive Indie Showcase Prize Pool, alongside premium professional assets such as Forge™ LUT Selection Pack, Forge™ SFX Pack to giveaway to top competitors of the Jam.

We are still working on enabling **Hardware Acceleration** within the **Ghost App Installer** to allow for GPU processing which should reduce the CPU overhead that is happening with the engine, making it more performant and less likely to freeze up your editor, and computer.

So look forward to that installer hopelly coming by **July 24, 2026** [img](https://github.com/Cleo876/wasm-video-editor/blob/main/IMGs/Meta-Data/WASM%20Video%20Editor%20META-DATA%20WallPaper.png?raw=true) [right]
